originalDefectRepairObservations.description: A stale timestamp bytecode cache previously supplied old dependency code despite different recorded source bytes. A direct native import demonstrates the stale code; validation now uses a fresh owned bytecode prefix and fails on the current source defect while preserving the existing cache.

physicalOutputsOmittedReason: Host synthetic diagnostics contain workstation paths; only their immutable hashes and bounded outcome accounting are published.
installedArtifactScope: The recorded tarball was evaluated before this measurement and status/inventory receipt declarations were emitted. Compiled engine and original callback bytes remain those evaluated; final Gate A package/matrix acceptance is separate.
